title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Pathogen Load Any Technique
description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Molecular pathogen load: Pathogen load — quantitative microbial nucleic acid, any technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Viral/bacterial loads (HIV RNA, HBV DNA, CMV DNA ...) regardless of technique. Reference set for the request. Parts: LOINC enumeration (401, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include.
